shared_elements: upright slab/monolith with rounded top carved in low relief
justification: Both are upright, roughly rounded-topped surfaces bearing shallow linear relief with human forms, circular discs and horizontal dividing bands, but these are generic features any relief tradition could produce independently. A is a single monumental anthropomorphic figure whose whole body is the surface, with a face, arms and a large chest disc, while B is a flat panel densely filled with rows of small repeated signs and miniature seated figures before offering tables in stacked registers — utterly different compositional logic and figure conventions.
